name: Chemical Materials Technology
description: Introduction to the classes of materials (crystalline, amorphous, semi-crystalline), atomic bonds, lattice, and structure with examples of metal oxides, metal carbides, and salts. Physicochemical attributes of particle: size, morphology, orderliness (degree of crystallinity), defects, porosity, mechanical strength. Introduction to philosophy of processing-structure-property-performance relationships. Heterogeneous catalytic materials. Electrical and optical materials: semiconductors and metals. Porous materials: adsorbents. Biomaterials. Soft materials. Materials characterization using spectroscopy and microscopy.
